defs.def: very serious and unpleasant, with a lot of anger and hatred involved 争论、分歧等

ex.s: Scientists have bitterly argued about which methods are the best, and, as we all know, bitter arguments rarely get resolved.
ex.t: 科学家们激烈地争论哪些方法最好，而众所周知，激烈的争论很少能解决。

ex.s: At that time, America was bitterly divided.
ex.t: 那时，美国处于严重的分裂之中。

defs.def: feeling angry and unhappy because you feel that you have been treated unfairly 人

ex.s: Oh you men who think or say that I am bitter, stubborn, or unfriendly, how greatly do you wrong me.
ex.t: 哦，你们这些认为或说我尖刻、固执或不友好的人，你们是多么冤枉了我。

defs.def: making you feel very unhappy; caused by great unhappiness 令人不快的；使人悲痛的；由痛苦引起的

ex.s: The Bitter Truth about Early Humans

defs.def: having a strong, unpleasant taste; not sweet 食物等
extremely cold and unpleasant 天气

ex.s: It was served cold and came with some sort of sticky sauce which tasted bitter and smelt really fishy!
ex.t: 它是冷着的，配了一种黏糊糊的酱汁，尝起来发苦，闻起来鱼腥味极重！

ex.s: This was the very door I ____2____ guided the children through to ensure their safety from the bitter cold.
ex.t: 这正是那扇我____2____引导孩子们穿过以确保他们免受严寒侵袭的门。

ex.s: （18）     ， I feel blessed someone had wanted to help a stranger． Erin had gone（19）     what almost anyone would have done， finding my house on a bitterly cold night and for that I was extremely（20）     ．
ex.t: （18）_____，我感到庆幸有人愿意帮助陌生人。艾琳在寒冷刺骨的夜晚找到我家，做了几乎任何人都不会做的事（19）_____，为此我极其（20）_____。

defs.def: a type of beer with a dark colour and a strong bitter taste, that is very popular in Britain 苦啤酒（在英国很受欢迎）
a strong bitter alcoholic liquid that is made from plants and added to other alcoholic drinks to give flavour 苦酒原汁（从植物中提取的苦酒精液体，可增加其他酒精饮料的味道）

ex.s: "Twenty years is a long time." He smiled bitterly, not knowing where to go.
ex.t: “二十年是一段漫长的时光。”他苦涩地笑了笑，不知该去往何处。

ex.s: Patience, they say, is what I must now choose for my guide, and I have done so - I hope my courage will remain firm to continue until the bitter end.
ex.t: 人们说，耐心是我此刻必须择以为向导的品格，我已然如此——但愿我的勇气能坚贞不渝，坚持到苦涩的终局。
